name: Lorelei
bio: Archetype: Deck-Based Buff, Ultimate Enhance. ⌽ Passively grants team buffs depending on the most common skill type in your hand. ⌽ S1 deals mass Mental damage and applies [Weakness]. ⌽ S2 increases ally DMG Taken Reduction and Crit DMG. ⌽ Ult gains additional power for each skill remaining in-hand and gains 1 Moxie on crit. ⌽ Great AFK buffer with occasionally very strong Ults.
